name: Videl
description: All-in-one Telegram bot: save restricted content, auto-rename & encode videos, clone FileStore bots, Stars premium.

DB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string (MongoDB Atlas free tier works)

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram user id (space-separated for several owners)

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Log channel id (-100…), the bot must be admin there

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Fernet key that encrypts clone-bot tokens (python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet;print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())")

MAX_LINK_FILES.description: Most files one clone-bot share/batch link may deliver

AIOGRAM_ENABLED.description: Use aiogram for newer Bot API features (coloured buttons, managed bots)

ENCODER_WORKERS.description: Encodes running at the same time

HW_ENCODER.description: GPU encoder: auto | nvenc | qsv | vaapi | off

SPLIT_SIZE_MB.description: Split uploads above this size (MB, max 1990)

FAST_DL_WORKERS.description: Parallel chunk requests per Telegram download (1-16, set FAST_DL=False to disable)

LEECH_PRO_GB.description: /leech size limit for Encoder Pro / Premium (GB)

ADMIN_WEB_TOKEN.description: Long random string – enables the /admin web dashboard (open /admin#TOKEN)

BACKUP_HOUR.description: Hour (0-23, LOG_TZ) for the daily database backup sent to the owner

DEFAULT_LANG.description: Fallback language: en hi ml ta es id ru ar
